notes:
Checks for updates every hour, and while the app is open.

- It used to check once a day, and only at launch. On an app that stays open all
  week that meant a build published on Tuesday morning was not offered until
  somebody happened to restart.

- Create project… on the menu page: a job before it has any drawings. Name,
  client, address, square feet and scope, a folder made for it, and any
  documents copied in — or none, which is the normal answer the day a job is
  won. It appears in Active projects straight away.

- Xero. Settings now takes a Custom Connection's client id and secret, kept in
  this Mac's keychain, and can prove the connection before anything depends on
  it.

- A finished download survives a quit, a failed check is written down instead of
  vanishing, and one failed check no longer spends the whole allowance.

- The front page survives being resized.
